//: One dedicated marker table + one dedicated privilege per consumer, enforced entirely by Dataverse's ExecutePrivilegeName + Security Role before RunFlowDispatcher ever runs (zero plugin code). To add a new consumer, copy a block below and change 'id' (letters/digits only) - append to the END of the list, don't reorder/delete from the middle. Re-run Deploy-FlowTriggerSolution.ps1 - it is idempotent and will only create what's missing. Every name below assumes the default '-PublisherPrefix flowtrig'.

consumers.description: flowtrig_RunFlow_TeamA / flowtrig_OnFlowRequested_TeamA, own 'Flow Trigger Caller - TeamA' role + own flowtrig_ep_teama marker table.
flowtrig_RunFlow_TeamB / flowtrig_OnFlowRequested_TeamB, own 'Flow Trigger Caller - TeamB' role + own flowtrig_ep_teamb marker table.
flowtrig_RunFlow_TeamC / flowtrig_OnFlowRequested_TeamC, own 'Flow Trigger Caller - TeamC' role + own flowtrig_ep_teamc marker table.
flowtrig_RunFlow_TeamD / flowtrig_OnFlowRequested_TeamD, own 'Flow Trigger Caller - TeamD' role + own flowtrig_ep_teamd marker table.
flowtrig_RunFlow_TeamE / flowtrig_OnFlowRequested_TeamE, own 'Flow Trigger Caller - TeamE' role + own flowtrig_ep_teame marker table.
